name: Yavimaya Bloomsage // Channel
oracle_text: At the beginning of your end step, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. Then if that creature has power 7 or greater, this creature becomes prepared. (While it's prepared, you may cast a copy of its spell. Doing so unprepares it.)
blocked_sentences: Until end of turn, any time you could activate a mana ability, you may pay 1 life. If you do, add {C}.

needs.what: a spell effect (the prepared face Channel) that gives its controller, until end of turn, a special action/mana ability owned by the player rather than a permanent: 'pay 1 life: add {C}', usable any time they could activate a mana ability, repeatable any number of times
needs.why_existing_wont_do: grant_ability only gives abilities to objects (selected permanents), so it cannot hand a mana ability to a player; emblems may not carry activated abilities (nothing offers activation from the command zone) and would be permanent rather than until end of turn; no static in static_effects grants a player a life-for-mana ability (add_mana_on_tap and double_*_mana only modify existing taps). The front face (end_step trigger, add_counters on a target, if power >= 7 then become_prepared with prepared_face) is expressible, but the prepared face must also be authored, so the card is blocked on the back.
